info.title: SignalPulse
info.description: Two-product trading intelligence platform. Product 1 — Market Analysis: natural language Q&A across FX, crypto, equities, sports, and racing; powered by an 11-layer intelligence stack; requires an analysis credit ($1.49/call). Product 2 — Trade Signals: cross-asset scanner covering 37 instruments (28 FX pairs, 4 metals/commodities, 5 global indices) plus sports and racing; returns actionable entry/SL/TP with full rationale; requires a signal credit ($2.49/call). Credit packs purchased at signalpulse.app — card or crypto. Credits are product-specific: analysis credits work only for /api/analysis; signal credits work only for signal/scan endpoints.

get.summary: Generate +EV bet and DFS plays for one match
get.description: Desk-quality single-game intelligence on demand. Returns the headline pick plus top_picks (3 ranked plays), each with edge_reason, confidence, market, availability, plus venue_conditions, athlete_intelligence, line_movement and avoid_if. Sports markets are read against the de-vigged book and our proprietary sport/weather engines. Position sizing, real-time alerts and the tracked record are the premium SignalPulse service. Cached briefly per matchup.
get.x-agent-chaining: Use ?sport=mlb (or wnba, soccer_epl, nba, nfl, nhl, tennis, mma, esports) with optional event= and market_type=. Pair with /api/scan/predmarket for the prediction-market cross-venue view. Agents pay $0.50 via x402; humans use a SignalPulse signal credit for the sized, tracked call.

get.summary: Report betting value on today's GB/IRE racing card
get.description: Desk-quality racing intelligence on demand. Returns scan_summary + top_pick (selection, event, bet_type, market_odds, implied vs our probability, edge, direction, confidence, rationale, key_edge) + value_picks + avoid + market_context, with the bet type chosen for the best edge (win/place/each-way/forecast/tricast). Reads the weathergoingform intersection, draw/trap bias and the pace map the casual punter ignores. Curated sizing, alerts and the tracked, calibrated record are the premium SignalPulse service. Cached briefly per card.
get.x-agent-chaining: Use ?type=horse (GB/IRE flat & jumps) or ?type=greyhound, with optional market_type= (win | place | each-way | forecast | tricast). Pair with /api/scan/game and /api/scan/predmarket for the full sports/markets view. Agents pay $0.50 via x402; humans use a SignalPulse signal credit for the sized, tracked call.

get.summary: Compare two named players head-to-head for betting
get.description: Desk-quality player-vs-player intelligence on demand. Returns betting_h2h (favoured player, bet_type, implied vs our probability, edge, confidence, rationale, key_edge) + fantasy_h2h (higher projection + reasoning - flagged when it diverges from the betting side) + props + avoid + market_context. Golf reads strokes-gained category fit to the course + history; tennis reads surface/form/fatigue; combat reads the style matchup. Curated sizing, alerts and the tracked record are the premium SignalPulse service. Cached briefly per matchup.

Pair with /api/scan/game and /api/scan/predmarket for the full sports view. Agents pay $0.50 via x402; humans use a SignalPulse signal credit for the sized, tracked call.

get.summary: Compare and rank 2+ players for betting value
get.description: Desk-quality multi-player ranking on demand. Returns ranking[] (rank, player, projection, the_case, confidence, in_data) + best_play (player, play_type, edge, rationale, key_edge) + fantasy_best (highest-value DFS play - flagged when it diverges from the betting best) + fade + market_context. Golf reads strokes-gained category fit to the course; tennis reads surface/form; combat reads the style matchup; team-sport players read usage/role + DFS points-per-dollar. Players not in the data block are ranked last and flagged (no fabrication). Cached briefly per group.

The N-way generalization of /api/scan/h2h. Agents pay $0.50 via x402; humans use a SignalPulse signal credit for the sized, tracked call.

get.summary: Generate fantasy start/sit, lineup and waiver advice
get.description: Desk-quality fantasy decisions on demand. Returns headline (the direct call) + rankings[] (rank, player, projected_points, floor_ceiling, role_usage, matchup, the_case, start, confidence, in_data) + lineup (DFS salary-cap build with points-per-dollar - lineup mode) + trade_verdict (accept/decline, winning side, value gap - trade mode) + upside_play + risk_flags + caveats. Usage-driven projections, calibration-disciplined; players not in the data block are flagged (no fabrication). Cached briefly per pool.
get.x-agent-chaining: Use mode=start-sit|lineup|waiver|trade. start-sit/lineup/waiver take ?players= (a-vs-b, comma, or repeated ?player=); trade takes ?give=…&get=…. Optional scoring=ppr|half-ppr|standard|dfs and slots=N. Pair with /api/scan/h2h for a single matchup. Agents pay $0.50 via x402; humans use a SignalPulse signal credit for alerts + the tracked record.

get.summary: Summarize one player's stat and fantasy outlook
get.description: Desk-quality single-player intelligence on demand. Returns outlook (form, role_usage, matchup, conditions) + projections[] (stat, projection, market_line, lean, edge, one_line - market line OPTIONAL, never invented) + fantasy (projected_points, floor_ceiling, start_worthiness, reasoning) + key_edge + risk + market_context. The N=1 case of the player engine - the betting props are analysis, the fantasy projection is a direct call. Players not in the data block are flagged (no fabrication). Cached briefly per player.

get.summary: Report a data-grounded answer to a sports question
get.description: Natural-language triage over the whole sports/markets engine. Auto-detects the sport, pulls its live intelligence, and answers: answer + confidence + data_backed[] (each citing a stat/source) + opinion[] (judgment, labeled) + key_factors + betting_angle (analysis) + fantasy_angle (direct advice) + best_endpoint (the deep read to call next) + caveats. The cheap triage layer that funnels to the deep paid reads (game/h2h/compare/fantasy/player/predmarket/racing). Cached briefly per question.
get.x-agent-chaining: Use ?q=<any sports/markets question> (optional &sport= to force detection). The orientation layer — read best_endpoint in the response, then call that named endpoint for the desk-quality read. Agents pay $0.50 via x402; humans use a SignalPulse signal credit.

get.summary: Compare the whole golf field for bets and fantasy
get.description: Desk-quality whole-field golf intelligence on demand - the agent twin of the premium signal/golf engine. Scans the live field by SG category profile against what the course demands, layering recent form, course history, and the AM/PM weather wave, then returns top_pick (player, bet type, market odds, edge, the case) + value_picks + the scan_summary course-fit read + avoid (the names to fade). compare/h2h handle named-golfer matchups; this is the full-field board. Cached briefly. Tournament weeks only - off-weeks return no_data.
get.x-agent-chaining: Call with optional market=outright|matchup|top-10|make-cut|first-round-leader|dfs to bias the bet type. Then drill named golfers via /api/scan/compare (3-balls/DFS pools) or /api/scan/h2h (2-balls). Agents pay $0.50 via x402; humans use a SignalPulse signal credit for the sized, tracked call.
